verifier: Adversarial verifier for integration lane world, round 1, 2026-10-29. I re-measured everything at HEAD b8be08b2 (= origin) on the dev server :5190 and the prod bench, in real Chrome (GPU). I did not take the engineers' reports on trust.
summary: Lane world passes round 1. The one major item, the Hooded Lamp knob ruling, is done in the source, the GLB and the icon, and the served asset matches. One minor item fails: world-05 was skipped on a premise that is no longer true. The client added minimapBounds support in 61fe088f, 17 s after the lane's first commit. integ_client_verify1 now holds client-14 and HUD-3 at partly, waiting only on this lane's half. Every other item re-measures as claimed, and my value_probe reproduces the engineers' numbers exactly. Base structures: RIFT L* p95 76 / 79, BRIDGE 73.5 / 76. BRIDGE Serenade plaza saturation 0.36. Wick top quarter, RIFT Low: 65.0, exactly on the cap with no margin. Canopy: High 52 / 91, Low 56 / 94. All gates on both maps and both tiers pass. perf_1080 --prod passes: High 434k triangles (canopy 66k -> 75k), 60.1 fps, 0 dropped. probe_wallmask is unchanged (0 of 48 spots under 50 %). probe_maps 102/102, content:check OK, typecheck exit 0. No regressions found. Sensitivity: I looked at every new icon, model render and in-game shot. I found no pointed hood, no face read and no Wick eye pair.
